content.purpose: Helps turn a project's contents into an appealing, informative overview that is easy to read.
content.whenToUse: Use it when a project needs a well-structured introduction grounded in the contents of its workspace.
content.outputs: Creates a concise, well-structured README.md in GitHub-flavored Markdown.

content.purpose: 协助将项目内容整理成吸引人、信息丰富且易于阅读的介绍。
